budget_scope: steady camera, warm caches; first-use LUT/AS uploads, resets, light-response and moving-camera peaks are excluded; no async overlap; shared RTX 4070 SUPER, approximately ten agents, no clock control or exclusive reservation
cleanup: obsolete shader cohorts and one-time manifest preparer removed; captures/goldens and 16KiB sheen directional-albedo engine asset retained
comparability: Sponza material import now includes normal/specular detail. Outdoor changes from 2084 proxy triangles to 49496 landscape/foliage triangles plus physical atmosphere. Each quality row has its own matched reference.
method: linear HDR relative RMSE before exposure; matched surface transport/materials; fixed exposure goldens; whole-frame p95 from per-frame GPU pass sums, not summed pass percentiles
motion_regression: GPU test failed against checkpoint cook (4.5m instead of 5m previous depth), passed after using previous deformed positions; next stationary frame correctly reports 4.5m
reference_limitations: Sponza 32768 spp at 640x360, 12 bounces; 16384-to-32768 residual is 0.319% globally and 2.801% in corridor. Outdoor/night 4096 spp at 480x270. Outdoor surface reference shares sky LUT/froxel display composition; HDR error is before fog, not independent volumetric ground truth.

visual_verdicts.night_interior: No: small-emitter mottling remains visible despite the denser gather; lower-half radiance RMSE is 15.83%; diagnostic geometry is not cinematic content.
visual_verdicts.outdoor_day: No: real landscape geometry, atmosphere/fog and alpha leaves work, but sparse procedural vegetation, simple ground art and visibly planar clouds are below a UE5 outdoor screenshot.
visual_verdicts.sponza: Not yet a finished UE5 Lumen cinematic: balanced bounce and detailed materials, but residual shadowed/contact detail softness; no general parity claim from one legacy asset view.
